proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ A B hA
  have ha : (A.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hA.card_ne_zero
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  rw [div_eq_div_iff ha h, div_mul_div_comm, div_eq_div_iff h (mul_ne_zero h h)]
  constructor
  · intro e
    calc ((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) * (Fintype.card Ω * Fintype.card Ω) = (((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) * Fintype.card Ω) * Fintype.card Ω := by ring
      _ = (B.card * A.card) * Fintype.card Ω := by rw [e]
      _ = (A.card * B.card) * Fintype.card Ω := by ring
  · intro e
    have : (((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) * Fintype.card Ω) * Fintype.card Ω = (B.card * A.card) * Fintype.card Ω := by linarith
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ h this
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (A B : Finset Ω), A.Nonempty → (((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) / A.card = (B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω ↔ ((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * ((B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω))
